captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a professional camera speedlight (flash) accessory. It features a solid black plastic body with a mounting foot at the bottom, a tall rectangular control column, and a swiveling yoke assembly at the top holding a forward-facing flash head. The flash head includes a prominent rectangular white diffuser lens, and the rear of the main body features a small rectangular display screen and physical button controls. Articulation points allow the head assembly to swivel horizontally on a vertical axis, and pitch vertically between the yoke arms.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a professional camera flash accessory with a mounting foot, a main control body, a swiveling yoke assembly, and a forward-facing flash head with a white diffuser screen. Define a revolute joint for the horizontal swivel of the head assembly, and a separate pitch joint for vertical rotation of the flash head.
captions.factory: The object is constructed by defining several parts in an assembly. The base mounting foot is built using box and cylinder primitives. The main vertical body is constructed from a box with chamfered edges, and a rear display screen is added as a separate visual. The yoke assembly is defined as a separate part containing two vertical arms. The flash head is created using a box with chamfered front edges, combined with a separate white rectangular diffuser lens. These parts are connected using revolute joints to enable horizontal panning of the yoke and vertical pitching of the flash head.
